T: Open only on holidays. Dinner every one of them.
D: A singer opens a country inn that only does business on holidays, and his old partner wants his girl.
P: Serve the main when the inn opens for Thanksgiving and the turkey shows up.
S: Heart-shaped sourdough toasts with tomato chutney and melted gruyère

Heart-shaped sourdough toasts topped with melted gruyère, sweet tomato chutney and thyme, grilled until golden and bubbling. Cut 8 hearts from 8 slices of sourdough with a heart cutter. Brush both sides with 30g melted butter and toast under the grill for 1 minute a side. Spread each with 1 tsp tomato chutney, then top with 150g grated gruyère and a few thyme leaves. Grill for 2 to 3 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling with brown spots. Finish with cracked pepper and serve hot.
Grilled corn with smoked paprika chilli butter

Grilled corn cobs brushed with smoked paprika and chilli butter, rolled in crumbled feta and finished with lime and coriander. Mash 60g soft butter with 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes, 1 crushed garlic clove and a pinch of salt. Grill 4 husked corn cobs over high heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred in places. Brush the hot cobs all over with the butter, then roll in 80g finely crumbled feta. Scatter with chopped coriander and serve with lime wedges.
M: Sage thyme butter turkey, mash, green beans and cranberry sauce

Herb-butter roast turkey breast with buttery mash, sage gravy, garlic green beans and a spoon of cranberry sauce. Mash 60g soft butter with chopped sage, thyme and 1 crushed garlic clove and push it under the skin of a 1.5kg turkey breast. Roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes, then rest 15 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Whisk 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, add 400ml chicken stock and simmer to a gravy. Blanch 300g green beans and toss with garlic butter. Serve with cranberry sauce.
Easter Parade honey glazed ham with spring greens
Easter at the inn, the night Jim and Linda dance to Easter Parade

A small leg ham studded with cloves and glazed with honey and mustard, with buttered new potatoes, asparagus and peas. Heat the oven to 180°C. Score the ham skin in diamonds, stud with cloves and brush with the honey, mustard and sugar. Bake, basting a few times, until glossy and hot through. Boil the potatoes until tender. Cook the asparagus and peas and toss everything with butter. Slice the ham to serve.

W: Christmas plum pudding with orange custard
Steamed Christmas pudding with warm vanilla and orange custard

Rich steamed fruit pudding served hot in wedges with warm orange custard poured over. Steam an 800g alcohol-free Christmas pudding in its basin over simmering water for 1 hour, or follow the packet. For the custard, warm 500ml milk and 200ml cream until steaming. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 60g caster sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour, pour in the hot milk while whisking, then return to the pan and stir over low heat until it thickens. Stir in the zest of 1 orange and 1 tsp vanilla. Turn out the pudding and pour over the custard.
K: White Christmas hot buttered apple punch
Jim's fireside drink the night he sings White Christmas to Linda

Warm cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves and orange, finished with a spoon of spiced brown sugar butter. Simmer 1.2L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 2 strips orange peel and 2 slices fresh ginger for 15 minutes without boiling. Mash 40g soft butter with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp molasses, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of nutmeg. Strain the punch into 4 mugs and drop in a teaspoon of the spiced butter to melt on top.

steps.text: Mash some of the butter with the chopped sage, thyme and one garlic clove. Halve and seed the pumpkin, score the flesh and spread the butter over.
Roast at 200C until soft and browned.
Boil the potatoes and mash with some of the butter and the milk.
Melt a little butter, whisk in the flour, add the stock and soy sauce and simmer to a gravy.
Blanch the beans and toss with the last of the butter and the other garlic clove. Serve with the cranberry sauce.
